description: The Phase 8 demo: the Kitchen's west wall W1 moved 1' west, by an applier that implements FS_furniture and knows it. No element changes - every host is relative - and the result is valid under FS_furniture; the pantry on W1 (X15), and the refrigerator, cabinets, range and dishwasher on W2 (X1 to X6), measured from W2's start J2, which moved, now derive placements 1' further west.
